defects: Uses `variationOn` instead of Mathlib's `eVariationOn`; Mathlib's BoundedVariation file has no two-argument real-valued `variationOn (f) (s)` declaration (the real-valued variant that exists, `variationOnFromTo`, takes four arguments and has a different definition), so this likely cites a nonexistent/fabricated declaration

Drops the general ambient set `s` and hypotheses `a ∈ s`, `b ∈ s`; only covers the special case s = univ (variation over Set.Icc a b alone) instead of variation over s ∩ Icc a b for arbitrary s containing a, b
Adds hypothesis `hab : a ≤ b` that is not present in the gold statement (gold avoids this via ENNReal.ofReal clamping negative differences to 0, remaining valid for a > b as well)
Equality is stated in ℝ (`= b - a`) rather than in ℝ≥0∞ via `ENNReal.ofReal (b - a)` as in the gold, changing the semantics/type of the conclusion
